title: Role Manifest
description: Every crew member needs a berth assignment before boarding — SwiftCargo's register form offers exactly four. Confirm the role dropdown lists all of them, no more, no fewer.
successCondition: On /register, the "Role" select element contains exactly four <option> elements with values admin, dispatcher, driver, customer (case-sensitive, matching the ROLES constant) — verified by reading the select's options collection, not just visually.
hints: The select is labelled "Role" via FormField's htmlFor/id pairing — use a label-based locator.
Order isn't part of the contract, only membership — assert on the set of values, not their position.
